title: MCP query_dataset with an empty selection.measures reaches the SQL driver and answers 500 DATABASE_ERROR, while the REST twin refuses it 400
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

## Reproduction (stock showcase at ee9ad834, keyed MCP session over /api/v1/mcp with an admin osk_ key; reproduced twice)

- `tools/call query_dataset {datasetName:"showcase_invoice_metrics", selection:{measures:[]}}` → `isError` `{error:{code:"DATABASE_ERROR", status:500, message:"The database refused to run a raw statement…"}}`. Server log: `[sql-driver] DATABASE_ERROR … SQLITE_ERROR … near "FROM": syntax error`.
- With `measures:[]` and `dimensions:["status"]`, the tool serves group rows that have no measures.
- REST twin: `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` with the same selection → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED "body.selection.measures must be a non-empty array of measure names."

Expected: the MCP door refuses the empty measure list before dispatch, with the same answer as the REST door; never a 500.

## Mechanism

The MCP input takes `DatasetSelectionSchema` by reference (`packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts:633`, `measures: shared.measures`), and that schema accepts an empty list. The REST route adds its own non-empty check (`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts:489`), which the MCP door lacks. The executor therefore builds a SELECT with no projection.

Fix direction: put the non-empty rule in the shared selection schema, or give the MCP input the same guard, and pin it in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-dataset-tools.test.ts`.

QA-source: #33025 · ai.mcp-dataset-tools · observed beside the clauses
